title: TRINITY ESALC-I GVPT2 and IR with analytic Wilson B prime
summary: Derive vibrational G prime analytically from Wilson B and B prime; acquire complete G double-prime by single-mode differences of G prime, with semidiagonal F4 and D3 from single-mode electronic points.
gates: Frozen ESALC-I chart and full vibrational rank
Cartesian-to-ESALC-I B/J closure and Wilson GF identity
Analytic Wilson B and Cartesian B prime at reference and plus/minus single-mode points; vibrational G prime derived by the mass-weighted product rule
Complete vibrational G double-prime from single-mode differences of derived G prime; no pair-mode metric samples
Complete F3 and semidiagonal F4 from only reference and plus/minus single-mode Cartesian Hessians
Semidiagonal D3 from single-mode analytic dipole Jacobians or dipole values; no pair-mode electronic samples
Fermi-only resonance polyads and second-order IR transition moments
coordinate_policy: Use one frozen full-rank ESALC-I chart. Obtain vibrational G prime from analytic B prime in the same chart. Displace one dimensionless normal mode at a time for Cartesian Hessians, dipole data, metric values and B/B prime. Differentiate G prime along each such mode to obtain every G_ij,kl; never request pair-mode electronic points.
backend_policy: KeyMaker authorizes Cartesian E/G/H and dipole providers; SMITH supplies Wilson B and analytic B prime; TRINITY constructs vibrational G prime, single-mode differences, Fermi-only GVPT2 and IR intensities.
